turn.content:
No earlier invoices against PO-2026-0003, so resubmission/over-billing aren't at issue. The contract has no Lampiran A price for either item; the only addendum concerns a different item (Cairan Pembersih Lantai 5L) effective 9 October 2026, which doesn't cover lines 3 or 4 and doesn't apply anyway since the invoice date is 2026-09-27.

Both lines exceed the PO price with no contractual authorization, so these are overcharges. I'll submit.
